faults.action: Arrian gives Eordaea, Elimiotis, the peaks of Stymphaea and Paravaea, Pelinna and Onchestus. Bosworth's Commentary on 1.7.5 takes him by Kozani and the Siatista pass to the upper Haliacmon and Grevena, on the eastern border of Tymphaea, and down the upper Peneus by Tricca. South of Pelinna Bosworth takes the inland route by Heracleia and Doris, and Plutarch 11.6 the pass of Thermopylae. The two run within about 20 km.
